## LmdbBackupStartOptions.s3Keep property

Remote archives to retain after each tick (default: `keep`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
s3Keep?: number;
```

## Remarks

Separate from [LmdbBackupStartOptions.keep](./lmdb.lmdbbackupstartoptions.keep.md) because off-host retention is usually longer than local — you prune local copies aggressively to save disk and keep the archive you can restore from anywhere. Falls back to `keep`<!-- -->, so a caller that never sets it behaves exactly as before.
